intendedClaim: A bounded additive workspace-test successor can preserve admitted package-prefix topology in disposable declared projections without symlinks,import rewrites,broad package copying or mutation of retained v3.

exactEvidenceRefs.role: exact failing test,missing module coordinate,closure and telemetry

evidenceObtained.finding: The unchanged exact owner did not reach application assertions;native Node returned ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND at the receipt-bound target and the disposable projection was deleted.
Both admitted canonical coordinates have the same exact member object hash;the receipt-bound target is absent.
The retained workspace-test owner writes only listed regular files and accepts no alias topology.
Prefix-alias meaning already exists in the closed SQLite application loader,but it is virtual and cannot be reused unchanged by native workspace tests.
Retained composed-successor qualification rejects symbolic links;ad-hoc links are inadmissible.
A retained earlier 40115-file projection encountered the same target omission;the defect is not candidate-specific.

findings: The retained alias model is scoped to virtual loader hooks;using it unchanged would replace native Node semantics.
Workspace-test v3 accepts no topology input and omits requested paths absent from the composed view.
The materializer has no alias entry kind.
Implicit whole-package copying would exceed the retained 512-output bound and exceed observed need.

decision.outcome: Prepare an additive workspace-test v4 successor only after separate executable-source authorization.

semantics: from is the disposable destination prefix;to is the canonical exact-snapshot source prefix.
members is a non-empty exact regular-file list;no directory inference occurs.
Each target is a verified regular-file copy of canonical bytes and mode;receipt records source,target,hash and mode.
Aliases are generated views only and create no canonical file,link,application authority or persistent state.
validation: Only declared mode;at most 16 aliases;no duplicate tuple.
Normalized relative Temple prefixes and members only;absolute,NUL,dot and traversal forms refused.
Distinct prefixes;overlap,chaining,cycles and ambiguous destinations refused.
Every source member exists in the exact snapshot and its hash is rechecked on read.
Every target remains contained and collides with no canonical,ordinary or alias target.
Ordinary plus expanded outputs remain at most 512;inspection rejects missing,mismatched,unexpected or non-regular objects.

proposedSurface: generated package evidence only after qualification
minimumExecutableSuccessor.successorHashPolicy: Review-only work authors no executable bytes. A later explicitly source-authorized tranche must bind exact successor paths and hashes before testing or admission.
